editorial:
Imagine you and your best friends from college heading to the mountains for one last big trip before real life hits. That is exactly where you start in this wild ride. You get a group of seniors who just want to party and relax in North Georgia, but they stumble upon a secret that turns their vacation into a nightmare. The vibe starts off light and fun, but it quickly shifts into a bloody scramble for survival once a weird contagion starts turning people into monsters. It feels like those classic teen slashers where you just hope your favorite character makes it out alive.

What really works here is how the movie balances the scary stuff with genuine laughs. The acting feels natural, and the action scenes move fast so you never get bored. While some of the plot twists are a bit predictable, the gore is handled well and keeps things exciting. If you are into zombie flicks that do not take themselves too seriously, you will love this. You should definitely stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video for the best picture, or maybe rent it on Apple TV for a quick movie night with friends.
endingExplained: The finale shows the remaining survivors fighting their way through the infested mountains to reach safety. You find out the contagion was part of a failed government experiment gone wrong. In the final moments, the lead character manages to kill the main source of the outbreak, but a cliffhanger reveals that one of the survivors was bitten. This means the virus is still out there, leaving the door open for a sequel.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves zombie movies with a side of comedy.
